This attachment has an order from a tribunal I cannot find in the filing menu.","sfx_cue":"thick file slapped onto counter, rubber stamp stops"},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Give me the bundle.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"The applicant wants the main affidavit taken today. He says this order is only supporting material.","sfx_cue":"paper bundle sliding across counter"},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Then I want to know what it supports.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"Possession, sir. The affidavit says possession changed because of this award.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Read the issuing authority.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"Arbitration and Dispute Resolution Forum. Presiding Officer.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Which district?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"It... it does not say.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Which appointing court?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"There is no appointment page attached.","sfx_cue":"pages flipped quickly"},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Case number.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"A D R F, slash, one seven six, slash, twenty-three.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"That is not one of ours.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"Should I return the filing? The counter is full, sir.","sfx_cue":"muffled litigants arguing behind glass"},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Accept the main affidavit provisionally. Detach nothing. Mark the complete bundle for scrutiny.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"Under which defect code?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Do not invent a defect because the menu is inconvenient. Write, authority not traceable.","sfx_cue":"keyboard tapping"},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"Authority not traceable. Yes, sir.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"And bring me the register for court-appointed arbitrators.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"NARRATOR","text":"The attachment had arrived as page forty-three of a file about something else. That was why nobody had hidden it.","sfx_cue":"metal records-room door rolling open"},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"Current register, sir. Retired appointments are in the bound volumes.","sfx_cue":"heavy ledger lowered onto desk"},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Start with the forum name.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"There are six panels using the words dispute resolution. None with this full name.","sfx_cue":"ledger pages turning"},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Search by the case number.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"Our arbitration references do not begin with A D R F.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Search anyway.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"Yes, sir.","sfx_cue":"computer keys clacking"},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"No result in district appointments. No result in transferred appointments. No result in closed references.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Now search the presiding officer's surname.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"It is not printed clearly. The seal crosses the signature.","sfx_cue":"paper rubbed flat"},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"The typed line beneath it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"Only, Presiding Officer.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"A title without a name.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"Maybe it is a private panel, sir. Parties do create private panels.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Private panels identify the arbitrator. Courts identify the appointing order. This identifies neither.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"There is a registry-clerk certification on the last page.","sfx_cue":"single page turned"},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Read it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"Certified that the proceedings above were recorded before the presiding officer, and that the award is a true copy.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Name of the clerk?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"A signature. Initial S. The rest is a long stroke.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Address?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"Second floor, above a tyre shop. No building number.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"A tribunal without a district, an arbitrator without a name, and a registry above a tyre shop.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"Should I call the number on the seal?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Not yet.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"Sir, if it is false—","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"We do not write false because something looks cheap. We write what the record proves.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"The record proves nothing exists under that name.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"The record proves we have not found it. Those are different sentences.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"NARRATOR","text":"By four thirty, three registers had failed to explain one sheet of paper.","sfx_cue":"office wall clock ticking, distant court bell"},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Bring the index of ad hoc appointments for the last five years.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"That index is handwritten, sir. It will take until closing.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Closing is a time. It is not permission to stop.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"Yes, sir.","sfx_cue":"chair scraping back"},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"Sir, the applicant is asking why his affidavit is held.","sfx_cue":"knock on open wooden door"},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"It is not held. It is under scrutiny.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"He says the other order was obeyed months ago. He has attached the handover receipt.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Show me.","sfx_cue":"loose paper placed down"},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"The losing party signed for payment and delivered possession.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Was counsel present before this forum?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"The appearance sheet lists an advocate.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Then this was not one confused man carrying a paper to a frightened shopkeeper.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"No, sir.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"How many annexures refer to the forum?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"Three. The award, the payment receipt, and the possession memorandum.","sfx_cue":"three pages tapped in succession"},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"All bearing the same case number?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"Yes, sir. One seven six.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Do not discuss it at the counter.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"I already asked two clerks if they knew the forum.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"And now half the corridor knows there is a paper we cannot identify.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"I... I was trying to clear the defect, sir.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"You did correctly by bringing it. You did incorrectly by making it corridor entertainment.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"FILING CLERK","text":"Sorry, sir.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Return to your counter. Say only that scrutiny is pending.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"NARRATOR","text":"The public counters closed. The unidentified order remained open on the registrar's desk.","sfx_cue":"metal shutters rattling down in distant corridor"},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"Sir, I checked every ad hoc appointment since twenty-eighteen. The forum name is absent.","sfx_cue":"ledger set down softly"},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"And the case number?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"It belongs to no sequence maintained here.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Leave the bundle with me.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"Do you want a formal verification note?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Tomorrow. First I want to see whether the number appears again.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RECORDS ASSISTANT","text":"Where will you keep it?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"Not the file. Only the number.","sfx_cue":"small paper slip torn from pad"},{"speaker":"NARRATOR","text":"He wrote A D R F, slash, one seven six, slash, twenty-three on the slip, and put it in his drawer.","sfx_cue":"pencil scratching, wooden drawer sliding shut"}]},{"ep":8,"title":"The Signature Beneath the Seal","lines":[{"speaker":"advocate","text":"Registry clerk, put your stamp here. Beneath your signature. Let everyone see what you certified.","sfx_cue":"rubber stamp struck hard on wooden desk"},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Why? The copy already has my signature.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"That is precisely why I want the stamp.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"The certified copy has been issued. Do not create theatre at my counter.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"Your counter has produced enough theatre. I am asking the clerk to read one sentence.","sfx_cue":"people murmuring in cramped room"},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Sir, should I give him another copy or not?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"No. The matter is complete.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"Then answer her. What does her signature certify?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"You appeared in one matter and received an award. You do not supervise my staff.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"I am trying to ensure your staff knows what you made her sign.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"I know. It says I recorded the proceedings.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"Did you?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"I called the numbers. I wrote who came. I kept the files.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"Did you record every statement printed in these proceedings?","sfx_cue":"pages shaken once"},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Not every word. Sir dictates the order later.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"Louder, please. The parties behind me paid to hear this court.","sfx_cue":"bench creaks, murmurs rise"},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"I said, he dictates later.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE IN ROOM","text":"Then what did she certify?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Silence. This is a registry, not a tea stall.","sfx_cue":"wooden paperweight struck on dais"},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"A registry of which court?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"A private dispute resolution forum. You knew that when your client signed consent.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"I knew the parties could appoint an arbitrator. I asked you for the appointment order.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"And I told you consent cured the absence of a prior order.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"You told me there was no prior appointment. Your clerk was standing beside you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Yes. I heard that.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"That matter is closed.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"Her signature is on matters she did not hear, beneath a seal that does not name an appointing authority. Her matter is not closed.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Sir... what is he saying?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"He is retiring without enough clients. Today he has chosen to perform for mine.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"Good. Humiliate me. But tell the girl what the words mean.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE IN ROOM","text":"We are waiting for our case. Why is nobody answering her?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"All matters are adjourned until two. Clear the room.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"There are seven people waiting. Two came from outside the city.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Clear the room, clerk.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"There. He remembers your designation when he needs obedience.","sfx_cue":"chairs scraping, files gathered"},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Please leave. Everyone, please. We will call you after two.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE IN ROOM","text":"Fourteen months she has sat here, and today she learns what her own stamp means.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"I said leave.","sfx_cue":"door pulled open, footsteps filing out"},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"Keep one uncertified copy for yourself. Do not let him take it.","sfx_cue":"single sheet placed on desk"},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Get out.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"I am going. She still remains on every page.","sfx_cue":"walking stick tapping away, door closing"},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Lock it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"What?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"The door. You said clear the room. Lock it.","sfx_cue":"door bolt sliding"},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Now tell me what my signature means.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"It means you issued a true copy from our file.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"He asked whether I recorded every statement.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Clerks certify proceedings. It is routine.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Which clerks? Court clerks?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Registry clerks.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"In a registered tribunal?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Private arbitration does not require the kind of registration you imagine.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Then show me your appointment.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Not this again.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Show me one page. Court appointment, party appointment, any appointment with your name.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Each consent memorandum appoints the forum for that dispute.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"The forum. Not you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"I am the presiding officer of the forum.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Who made you presiding officer?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"I established the forum.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"You made the room, then the room appointed you?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Do not reduce legal arrangements to foolish sentences.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Then give me the clever sentence. I have asked four times.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Parties came voluntarily. They argued. They accepted decisions. You saw them comply.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"That is not an appointment.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"It is jurisdiction by consent.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Is this a court?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"People use the word court loosely.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"You use it. Every day. You say, call the court to order.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"It creates discipline.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"You made me say, all persons having business before this court.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"A formal opening helps parties behave.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"You made me stand when you entered.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Do not say made. I gave you a respectable designation when nobody else would interview you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"There. That is the answer you were saving.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"It is the truth. You had never worked. You could not type properly. I trained you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"And because I was grateful, you put my name where you would not put yours.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"My signature is on every award.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Under a title. The title hides your name. My certification does not hide mine.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Nobody is coming for you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Someone already asked for the appointment order.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"An old advocate asked. He left with nothing.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"And if a real registry asks?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Why would it? We choose private disputes. We do not interfere with pending court matters.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"How do you know what is pending?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"I check.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Where? I have never seen you check any public website.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"That is administrative work. It does not concern your certification.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Everything suddenly does not concern me, except the signature.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"You were paid to maintain records, and you maintained them.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Paid. Yes.","sfx_cue":"metal cash box latch opening"},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"One envelope for the first month. Three thousand rupees.","sfx_cue":"paper envelope set down"},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Second month. Three thousand.","sfx_cue":"second envelope set down"},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Then four thousand, after you said the registry was growing.","sfx_cue":"more envelopes dropped onto desk"},{"speaker":"morris","text":"You earned every rupee.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Fourteen salary envelopes. Fourteen months calling case numbers I did not understand.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"You understand them now. They are disputes resolved faster than any district court could resolve them.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"And these certified copies went outside this room?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Parties take copies. Naturally.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Banks? Land offices? Police stations? Real courts?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"I do not follow every party after judgment.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"But my signature follows them.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Listen to me. No one was cheated. Manjula got her keys. Irfan got his home. People obey because the decisions are fair.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Fair does not make you appointed.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Do not repeat that advocate's language as if you studied law overnight.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"I did not study law. Your court is above a tyre shop. Mine has vigilance officers.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Your pending list built my docket.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pandit","text":"My list kept you away from cases that could expose you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"And I paid your price every month.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pandit","text":"Did you?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"I opened every sealed envelope. I asked no questions.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pandit","text":"Opening was not the price.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"I heard the matters you sent.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pandit","text":"And ruled as each envelope instructed.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"The rulings were legally supportable.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pandit","text":"One envelope said release the deposit. You released it. One said restrain the workshop owner. You restrained him.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"After hearing both sides.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pandit","text":"One said award sixty percent of the disputed stock to the supplier. Your order said sixty percent.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Because the invoices proved sixty percent.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pandit","text":"Your reasons changed. My result never did.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"You brought disputes that needed quick resolution.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pandit","text":"I brought outcomes people paid to receive.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"You told me never to ask who.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pandit","text":"And you enjoyed not asking. It let you sit higher than the people paying you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"How much did you take from them?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pandit","text":"There. Fourteen months, and today you discover curiosity.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"How much?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pandit","text":"Enough that they expected the exact operative line.
